subject.title: [bug] 10 skills stuck in pending_checks after staged prepublication pipeline deployment

question: How should ClawHub restore and reconcile blocked staged publishes while preserving the intended prepublication security boundary?
rationale: The observable bug is a production publishing outage, but the repair choices affect whether TruffleHog and ClawScan remain mandatory before public listing, so automation should not choose the bypass/security contract on its own.

options.title: Follow the root incident contract
options.body: Repair worker finalization, treat suspicious as public but flagged, keep malicious and verified secrets blocked, then reconcile and verify the specific affected attempts.

options.title: Approve a scoped operator bypass
options.body: Allow a temporary maintainer/operator-only recovery path for known-good attempts with audit logs and a follow-up to remove or harden it.

options.title: Accept a caller bypass
options.body: Let publishers opt out of staged checks with a payload flag, accepting the broader risk that API callers can skip the prepublication gate during outages.

recommendation.title: Follow the root incident contract
recommendation.body: Repair worker finalization, treat suspicious as public but flagged, keep malicious and verified secrets blocked, then reconcile and verify the specific affected attempts.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick authored the staged publishing and worker paths and opened the root incident that defines the desired security contract.
